name: BannerAction
description: The banner's buttons: at the end of the last line of text, centered on it, while the text fits beside them on one line; on a line of their own under the text, aligned to the end, when it doesn't or the banner is narrower than 480px.

name: BannerClose
description: The × of a banner that has no button: a frameless icon button at the end of the first line, centered on it, its icon box ending on the banner's padding. Never put it in `BannerAction`.

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).
